start.speaker: steward
start.text: Name? Sorry, sorry, it's the jump, everyone gets nervous at the jump. Passenger {name}, cabin 4-C. Ah. You're the... Lattice Corps. Discharged.

vet.speaker: steward
vet.text: My nephew was a vanguard on the Callan line. Came home with half his hearing. Thank you for, well. For whatever you did out there.

col.speaker: steward
col.text: You're... Haldis-born? Born there and flew for the Concord. That can't have made you many friends on either side. I'm not judging. I'm a purser. I count people, I don't weigh them.

sal.speaker: steward
sal.text: Breaker yards after the corps, it says. Then you can probably fix the sim booth. It's eaten three of Brann Ketterick's tokens.

hub.speaker: steward
hub.text: Muster check-in only takes a moment, but corridor C-3 stays in departure lockdown until the jump spools, so there's no hurry. There's a card table, the racing sim, and the requisition terminal still takes colony scrip.

choices.text: What is this ship actually carrying?
Those ships shadowing us off the port side. Who are they?
How are the other passengers holding up?
Tell me about the WARDEN defense network.
Check me in. I'm ready.
I'll take a look around first.

again.speaker: steward
again.text: Back again? Check-in's open whenever you're ready, {name}.

choices.text: What is this ship actually carrying?
Who's shadowing us?
Check me in.
Later.

cargo.speaker: steward
cargo.text: Passengers, mostly. Medical supplies. And the archive hold, which I'm told contains 'Concord medical archive cores for the Tessaly tribunal' and which I'm told, firmly, not to ask about. Commander Varr has the only access. The WARDEN guards it.

choices.text: A tribunal? Who's on trial?
Back to the other questions.

tribunal.speaker: steward
tribunal.text: War crimes inquiry, the bulletins say. Both sides accuse the other. I don't follow it. I count heads and hand out blankets.

lantern.speaker: steward
lantern.text: Lantern Office pickets. Haldis Free Assembly. Reclamation corps, they call themselves. They've been hailing us since orbit, demanding we 'return what was taken'. The commander isn't answering. Don't worry: the Concord flag still means something out here.

choices.text: And if it doesn't?
Back to the other questions.

lantern2.speaker: steward
lantern2.text: Then I suppose we find out what the WARDEN is for.

people.speaker: steward
people.text: Frightened. The Venn woman's boy hasn't said a word since we boarded. Brann's losing at cards to calm his nerves. Three of the medical deck's patients are in a bad way. Don't tell anyone I said that.

warden.speaker: steward
warden.text: Integrated defense lattice. Concord surplus from the war, refitted. It runs the turrets, the security drones, the locks. It's never said a word to me in three years. It talks to the commander. Honestly, it gives me the shivers.

boom.speaker: narrator
boom.text: The deck jumps. Light fixtures swing on their cables. A long groan of tortured metal rolls forward from the stern, then a muffled thud, then another. Every panel in the commons flashes red.

warden_says.speaker: warden
warden_says.text: ARCHIVE PROTECTION PROTOCOL ENGAGED. HULL BREACH: DORSAL, ARCHIVE SECTION. BOARDERS DETECTED. ALL NON-ESSENTIAL PERSONNEL ARE CLASSIFIED AS ARCHIVE OBSTRUCTIONS. OBSTRUCTIONS WILL BE CLEARED. PLEASE REMAIN STILL.

dray2.speaker: steward
dray2.text: Remain — WARDEN, belay that! I am the purser, these are passengers! Oh, saints. Oh no. Listen to me. Everyone stay in the commons. {name}! You were Lattice Corps. Security's pinned down in corridor C-3, I can hear them on the band. Please. I can't — I count people.

choices.text: Keep everyone here and keep them calm. I'll go.
The corridor's the way forward anyway. I'll see what's there.
Why should I risk my neck for the ship's security?
Dray. Breathe. Lock this door behind me and do not open it for anything that isn't human.

go_c.speaker: steward
go_c.text: Thank you. Thank you. We'll be right here.

go_p.speaker: steward
go_p.text: Forward, yes. The launch craft's forward too. Bay 2. If anyone makes it off this ship, it's from there.

go_s.speaker: steward
go_s.text: Because the launch craft is past them! Because if security falls there's nobody between those drones and the rest of us! I — please.

go_h.speaker: steward
go_h.text: Nothing that isn't human. Right. Right.

unlock.speaker: system
unlock.text: The lockdown on Corridor C-3 releases. Purser Dray gathers the passengers around Muster Point B; they will follow your route toward the launch bays.

after.speaker: steward
after.text: We're holding here, like you said. Bay 2, {name}. The launch craft is at Bay 2. Please hurry.

choices.text: Stay together. I'll come back for you or clear the way.
Go.
